Subject: Internal — Crestpoint request: staged remit / pause dunning?

Team — quick internal note summarizing Crestpoint's ask: 50% partial payment if we accept staged remit and issue either (A) a reissued invoice to the UK entity or (B) a payment plan confirming they won't dunning while the transfer completes. They will pay 50% on 9/13 once we have an agreement.

Questions for finance/legal:
- Can we legally accept a split remit across Redwood entities without rebooking revenue exposure?
- How do we handle VAT allocation on our side if invoice is reissued to a UK entity?
- Is there any reason we should not pause dunning for two weeks pending partial payment?

Marcus, any constraints on accepting a 50% partial and reissue? Kimberly, what do you need from legal to pause dunning safely?

I propose: temporary hold of automated dunning, require signed payment plan + 50% cleared by 9/13, else immediate escalation to collections and exec notification.

Thanks,
Logan
From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: logan_wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 11:07:44 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal — Crestpoint request: staged remit / pause dunning?

Logan — from finance perspective:

- Accepting a 50% partial payment is acceptable if we recognize the partial as non-final (apply to outstanding AR) and keep a hold on service escalations. We'll need a signed payment plan that assigns responsibility for the remainder and an entity routing instruction.
- Reissuing the invoice to a different legal entity is possible but requires us to void the original invoice and reissue (affects revenue timing and tax). That will need coordination with tax/legal.
- VAT: if they want reverse-charge to apply, we need their UK VAT ID and evidence of intra-EU (now UK) supply. Marcus recommends we request their VAT ID and confirm with tax team; that should be a condition of the staged remit.

Bottom line: I support the staged remit conditional on: signed payment plan, 50% cleared by 9/13, Crestpoint UK VAT ID + PO match.

Marcus

Subject: Exec decision requested — Crestpoint staged payment plan and temporary dunning hold

Marissa — quick escalation for your approval. Crestpoint (strategic account) is requesting a temporary pause to automated dunning in exchange for a signed staged payment plan and 50% payment by 9/13. Risks: cross-entity invoicing complexity and delayed final settlement. Benefits: preserves relationship and recovers partial revenue this month.

Proposed terms (two options):
1) Reissue invoice to Crestpoint UK Ltd and accept 50% payment now; tax/legal to coordinate rebooking (longer path).
2) Keep original invoice; require signed staged payment plan (DocuSign) and 50% bank transfer by 9/13; we pause dunning for 10 business days. If payment misses, automatic escalation to collections + notify execs.

We have PO and internal tax certificate from Crestpoint. Marcus recommends option 2 for speed. Kimberly needs exec sign-off to pause dunning for a short, documented window.

Can you confirm approval for option 2 (staged payment plan + 10-business-day pause) so we can send DocuSign and avoid pushing them into collections prematurely?

Thanks,
Logan
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: logan_wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 12:18:37 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec decision requested — Crestpoint staged payment plan and temporary dunning hold

Approved: option 2.

Conditions:
- We pause automated dunning for up to 10 business days, conditional on DocuSign-signed payment plan and 50% cleared funds by 09/13 EOD PT.
- DocuSign must include a clause: if payment is not received by the date in the plan, Redwood may resume dunning and apply a one-time reactivation fee and route the account to collections.
- Collections to prepare standard escalation notice to be sent automatically if breach occurs; legal to be notified.

Logan — proceed to send the DocuSign (use HS-48392 in the cover note) and confirm once payment clears. Keep me posted if there is any slippage.

Marissa
VP, Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
